description: Per-million-token USD pricing for token/cost tracking in eval records. Two families: the Claude API list rates (sonnet/haiku/opus) and the serverless provider rates this instance's eval records actually carry (the ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL tier aliases — see notes).
notes: CLAUDE LIST RATES (Anthropic first-party API): sonnet 3/15 = Sonnet 4.6, haiku 1/5 = Haiku 4.5, opus 5/25 = Opus 4.6/5. opus was added 2026-10-16 (Stage 5 finding #4): 4 step entries carried model=opus with a null cost_usd because the table lacked an opus key.

PROVIDER TIER ALIASES: this instance routes Claude tiers to Fireworks serverless models (~/.claude/settings.json ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL). The eval records' `model` field carries the provider model id, not the tier name, so the table prices those ids at their REAL configured provider rates (the rates the instance is actually billed):
Opus   tier -> glm-5p3 / glm-latest ($1.4/$4.4 per Mtok) [ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL]
Fable  tier -> glm-5p3-flash / glm-flash-latest ($0.15/$0.5 per Mtok) [ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL]
Both spellings of each provider id are listed where they appear in the data (full 'accounts/fireworks/models/<id>' from transcripts, short '<id>' from step frontmatter).

STILL UNPRICED (documented, not fabricated): accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-pro-0813 — no configured rate found; left null. A null cost_usd on any model absent from this table means 'unpriced model', not 'capture failure'.
